फ: फ 1. फ, the twenty-second consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and the second letter of the fifth or labial class, being the aspirate of प्, and said to be pronounced like फ् in uphill, loophole. —फ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound फ्।

फ 2. फ, अस्, आ, अम्, evident, manifest; (अस्), m. the performance of a mystical rite by which Kuvera's attendants are propitiated; increasing, swell-ing, enlarging, expanding; an augmenter, increaser; fruitfulness, fertility, gain; a high wind, a gale; yawning with the mouth wide open; (अम्), n. blowing, panting; bursting with a popping noise (as air bubbles &c.); bubbling, boiling; angry speech; unprofitable or idle speech; [cf. फा।]
फक्क्: फक्क् फक्क्, cl. 1. P. फक्कति, पफक्क, फक्किष्यति, अफक्कीत्, फक्कितुम्, to move slowly, go softly, creep, steal along; to have a preconceived opinion; to behave ill, act wrongly, act in a low or unjust manner; to swell: Caus. फक्कयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अपफक्कत्: Desid. पिफक्किषति: Intens. पाफक्क्यते।
फक्किका: फक्किका, f. a preconceived opinion, previous statement; a position, assertion or argument to be proved, thesis to be maintained; logical exposition or elucidation; a sophism, a trick, illusion, fraud; N. of a commentary on the Tarka-saṅgraha.
फगुल: फगुल फगुल, अस्, m., N. of a man; (perhaps incorrectly for फल्गुन।)
फञ्जी: फञ्जी फञ्जी, f. the plant Clerodendrum Siphonanthus; [cf. जीर्ण-फ्°।]
फञ्जिका: फञ्जिका, f. Clerodendrum Siphonanthus; Li-peocercis Serrata (= देव-ताड); Alhagi Maurorum (= दुर्-आलभा).
फञ्जिपत्त्रिका: फञ्जि-पत्त्रिका, f. a species of plant (= आखु-पर्णी; also read फञ्जि-पुत्रिका).
फट्: फट् फट्, an onomatopoetic word used mystically in incantations.
फट: फट फट, अस्, आ, m. f. (probably fr. rt. स्फट्; = स्फट), the expanded hood or neck of a serpent [cf. फण]; a tooth; a cheat.
फडिङ्गा: फडिङ्गा फडिङ्गा, f. a cricket, grasshopper, locust.
फण्: फण् फण्, cl. 1. P. फणति, पफाण (2nd sing. फेणिथ or पफणिथ, 3rd pl. फेणुस् or पफणुस्), फणिष्यति, अफणीत्, अफाणीत्, फणितुम्, to go, go about, move: Caus. फणयति, फाणयति, -यितुम्, to cause to spring or run (Ved.); फाणयति, to scum, skim, take off (the surface of a fluid); to produce easily or without exertion: Desid. पिफणिषति: Intens. पम्फण्यते, पम्फणीति, पम्फण्टि।
फण: फण, अस्, m. (perhaps) scum, froth (Ved.); (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. the expanded side of a nostril; (अस्, आ), m. f. the expanded hood or neck of the cobra di capello (= फट); अङ्गुली-फण-हस्तक, one in whose hands the fingers take the shape of a hood; [cf. गो-फणा।] —फण-कर, अस्, m. the cobra di capello, Coluber Naga; a snake in general. —फण-गिरि, see फेन-गिरि. —फण-त्रय, अम्, n. three hoods (of a snake). —फण-धर, अस्, m. = फण-कर; an epithet of Śiva. —फण-भृत्, त्, m. = फण-कर; a symbolical expression for the number nine (or eight). —फण-मणि, इस्, m. ‘hood-gem,’ a jewel supposed to be found in the hood of a snake. —फण-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘hood-orb,’ the rounded hood (of a serpent). —फ-ण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a hood, hooded; (आन्), m. the cobra di capello, a snake in general. —फ-ण-श्रेणी, f. a line or row of serpents’ hoods. —फण-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a serpent's hood (as a gem). —फणा-कर, अस्, m. = फण-कर। —फणाटोप (°ण-आट्° or °णा-आट्°), अस्, m. the swelling of a serpent's hood. —फणाटोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having the hood swollen (said of a serpent). —फणातपत्र (°ण-आत्° or °णा-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a hood for a parasol (said of a serpent). —फणा-धर, अस्, m. = फण-धर. —फ-णा-फलक, अम्, n. the flat surface of a serpent's hood. —फणा-भर, अस्, m. the cobra di capello. —फणा-भृत्, त्, m. ‘hood-bearing,’ a snake, serpent. —फणा-मणि-सहस्र-रुच्, f. the splendor of the thousand jewels on the hood (of the serpent-king, Māgha IX. 25). —फणा-वत्, आन्, m. ‘pos-sessing a hood,’ the cobra di capello, a snake.
फणिका: फणिका, f. the tree Ficus Oppositifolia. —फ-णिकेश्वर (°का-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of one of the eight Vīta-rāgas of the Buddhists; [cf. फणीन्द्रेश्वर।]
फणिकार: फणिकार, अस्, m. an epithet of Piṅgala, (perhaps incorrectly for फण-कर or फणा-कर, which would be analogous to his epithets नाग-राज and भुजङ्गेश); N. of a people, (also read कर्णिकार।)
फणित: फणित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; diluted (?).
फणिन्: फणिन्, ई, m. the hooded serpent, cobra di capello, a serpent in general; an epithet of Rāhu; of Patañjali; a species of herb (= सर्पिणी). —फ-णि-कन्या, f. the daughter of a serpent-demon. —फणि-केशर or फणि-केसर, अस्, अम्, m. n. Mesua Roxburghii (= नाग-केसर). —फणि-जा, f. a species of plant (= Marāṭhī झरसी). —फणि-जिह्वा, f. ‘serpent's tongue,’ N. of a plant (= महा-शतावरी); the plant Sida Cordifolia (= महा-स-मङ्गा). —फणि-जिह्विका, f. the plant Emblica Officinalis; = फणि-जिह्वा. —फणि-तल्प-ग, अस्, m. ‘resorting to a serpent as a couch,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —फणि-पति, इस्, m. ‘serpent-king,’ N. of the serpent Śeṣa; of Patañjali. —फणि-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘serpent's friend,’ wind. —फणि-फेण, अस्, m. ‘snake's saliva,’ opium (= अहि-फेण). —फणि-भारिका, f. the tree Ficus Oppositifolia (= फ-णिका). —फणि-भाष्य, अम्, n. the commentary of Patañjali (= महा-भाष्य). —फणि-भुज्, क्, m. ‘serpent-eater,’ a peacock. —फणि-मुख, अम्, n. ‘serpent's mouth,’ a kind of spade used by housebreakers. —फणि-लता or फणि-वल्ली, f. betel-pepper (= नाग-वल्ली). —फणि-हन्त्री, f. the plant with which the ichneumon is said to cure itself after the bite of a snake (= गन्ध-नाकुली). —फणि-हृत्, त्, f. a kind of plant (= क्षुद्रा दुर्-आलभा)। —फणीन्द्र (°णि-इन्°), अस्, m. ‘serpent-chief,’ an epithet of the serpent-demon Śeṣa; an epithet of Patañjali (= फणिन्). —फणीन्द्रेश्वर(°र-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of one of the eight Vīta-rāgas of the Buddhists; [cf. फणिकेश्वर।] —फणीश (°णि-ईश), अस्, m. ‘serpent-chief,’ an epithet of Patañjali (= फणिन्). —फणीश्वर (°णि-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘ser-pent-chief,’ an epithet of the serpent-demon Śeṣa; an epithet of Patañjali (= फणिन्).
फणीय: फणीय, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Cerasus Puddum (= पद्म-काष्ठ).
फण्ड: फण्ड, अस्, m. the belly (= फाण्ड).
फणिखेल: फणिखेल फणिखेल, अस्, m. a quail; (pro-bably incorrectly for फाल-खेला।)
फणिज्झक: फणिज्झक फणिज्झक, अस्, m. marjoram and another similar plant; (आ), f. a plant, apparently a species of basil with small leaves (commonly called राम-दूति).
फणी: फणी फणी, f., N. of a river.
फत्: फत् फत्, ind. an interjection, in फत्-कृ probably an error for फुत्-कृ।
फतिहशाह: फतिहशाह फतिह-शाह, N. of a king of Kaśmīra (= شاه فتح ).
फतेपुर: फतेपुर फतेपुर, अम्, n., N. of a city.
फर्: फर् फर् for फॄ = पॄ, Ved. to fill.
फर्वर: फर्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. filling, (Sāy. = पू-रयितृ।)
फर: फर फर, अम्, n. a shield (= फलक).
फरञ्ज: फरञ्ज फरञ्ज, N. of a place.
फरुवक: फरुवक फरुवक, अम्, n. a betel-box (= पूग-पात्र).
फरेन्द्र: फरेन्द्र फरेन्द्र, अस्, m. Pandanus Odora-tissimus.
फर्फराय: फर्फराय फर्फराय, Nom. A. फर्फ-रायते, -यितुम्, to glance about, dart to and fro.
फर्फरीक: फर्फरीक फर्फरीक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. स्फुर्), the palm of the hand with the fingers extended; (आ), f. a shoe, = मदन, q. v.; (अम्), n. softness, sweetness; a young shoot or branch.
फर्व्: फर्व् फर्व्, cl. 1. P. फर्वति, &c., Ved. to go.
फल्: फल् फल्, cl. 1. P. फलति, पफाल (3rd pl. फेलुस्), फलिष्यति, अफालीत्, फलितुम्, to split (intrans.) cleave asunder, burst, cleave open (intrans.), burst open, burst asunder (Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 7472); to bear fruit, yield or produce fruit, (सम्पदः फल्, to bring forth successes as fruit, have a reward); to be fruitful; to have results or consequences; to result; to succeed; to be fruitful in, be fulfilled by (with abl.); to fall to the share of any one (with loc.), befall; to be useful; to become ripe, ripen; to produce; to shine back, be reflected; to go (for पल्): Caus. फालयति, अपी-फलत्: Desid. पिफलिषति: Intens. पम्फुल्यते, पम्फुल्ति; [cf. Gr. ἐκ-φλαίν-ω, ἔ-φλαδ-ον, φλα-σ-μό-ς πα-φλάζ-ω; perhaps ὄφελος, ὀφέλλω: Lat. fla-re, fla-tu-s, flâ-men, flâ-bru-m, flô-s, flôr-eo, Flora: Osc. Flusa: Goth. uf-blês-an, bloth, blô-ma: Old Germ. blâ-an, ‘to blow;’ blus-jan, ‘to bloom;’ bluot, ‘a blossom;’ blâs, ‘blowing;’ blâsa, bla-tara, ‘bladder;’ bluot, ‘blood;’ bloz, ‘proud:’ Angl. Sax. blowan, bloma, blostma: Cambro-Brit. pâl, ‘a spread;’ palad, ‘a shooting or spreading out;’ paladu, ‘to spread or shoot out.’]
फल: फल, अम्, n. a fruit, fruit (especially that of a tree); produce, crop; a kernel, (दाडिम-फ्°, the kernel of a pomegranate); fruit metaphorically, offspring, progeny, a child (Raghu-v. XIV. 39); a result, consequence, effect [cf. निष्-फ्°, पुण्य-फ्°, पुरः-फ्°]; profit, gain, interest on capital, ad-vantage, benefit, utility; recompense, reward, prize, meed, retribution (good or bad); detriment, loss, disadvantage; (in mathematics) the result of a cal-culation, product or quotient, result (in trigonome-try); second term in a rule of three sum; corrective equation; area or superficial contents of a figure; a nutmeg; the three myrobalans (= त्रि-फला); a testicle; a blade (of a sword or knife, cf. खड्ग-फ्°); a tablet, board [cf. शारि-फ्°]; a shield; the point of an arrow, head of a dart or spear; a point or spot on a die; a ploughshare (= फाल); the menstrual discharge [cf. नव-फलिका, पुष्प]; a gift, giving; (अस्), m. the plant Wrightia Antidy-senterica, = कुटज; (आ), f. a species of shrub, = झिञ्झिरिष्टा; (ई), f. a species of fragrant plant (= फलिनी, प्रियङ्गु); a kind of fish (= फलि)। —फल-कक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a Yakṣa. —फल-कण्टका, f. the plant Asclepias Echinata. —फल-कामना, f. desire of a result or consequence. —फल-काल, अस्, m. the time of fruits, fruit season. —फल-कृष्ण, अस्, m. Carissa Carandas or Flacourtia Cataphracta (= कृष्ण-पाक-फल)। —फल-केशर, अस्, m. ‘having fruit for hair,’ the cocoa-nut tree (the fruit of which is covered with a fibrous coat resembling hair). —फल-कोश or फल-कोषक, अस्, m. the covering of the testicles, the scrotum. —फल-खण्डन, अम्, n. the destruction of fruits, frustration of results, dis-appointing. —फल-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘receiving fruits,’ deriving profit or advantage, benefited; (अस्), m. the deriving profit or advantage, being benefited. —फल-ग्रहि, इस्, इस्, इ, fruitful, bearing fruit in due season. —फल-ग्रहिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, fruit-bearing, fruitful. —फल-ग्राहिन्, ई, m. ‘fruit-bearer,’ a tree (properly a fruit tree). —फल-घृत, अम्, n., Ved. ‘fruit-ghee,’ N. of an aphrodisiac for men (which is composed of various ingredients, and said to be the invention of Bharad-vāja); N. of a powerful me-dicament used in diseases of the uterus. —फल-चमस, अस्, m. ‘fruit-goblet,’ a cup containing fruit instead of Soma (Ved. the fruit consisting of pounded figs, young leaves, and sour milk); the bark of the Indian fig-tree (ground and eaten with curds by way of penance). —फल-चारक, अस्, m. ‘fruit-distributor,’ a particular official in Buddhist monasteries. —फल-चोरक, अस्, m. a kind of perfume. —फ-ल-च्छदन, अम्, n. a house built of wooden boards. —फल-तस्, ind. consequently, accordingly, virtu-ally. —फल-ता, f. or फल-त्व, अम्, n. the being fruit, the state of fruit. —फल-त्रय, अम्, n. ‘fruit-triad,’ three sorts of fruit collectively (the fruit of the vine with those of Grewia Asiatica or Xylocarpus Gra-natum and Gmelina Arborea); the three myrobalans. —फल-त्रिक, अम्, n. ‘fruit-triad,’ the three myro-balans. —फल-द, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘fruit-giving,’ yield-ing or bearing fruit; bringing profit or gain; giving a reward, rewarding; (अस्), m. a tree (properly a fruit tree). —फल-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, or फल-दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ‘fruit-giving,’ yielding fruit; giving a result. —फल-निर्वृत्ति, इस्, f. final consequence or result. —फल-निवृत्ति, इस्, f. cessation of con-sequences. —फल-निष्पत्ति, इस्, f. production of fruit, bearing fruit, yielding profit, having the desired results. —फल-पञ्चाम्ल, अम्, n. a collection of five kinds of acid vegetables and fruits; (see फ-लाम्ल-पञ्चक।) —फल-परिणति, इस्, f. the ripe-ness of fruit. —फल-पाक, अस्, m. the ripening of fruit; the fulness of consequences; Carissa Carandas or Flacourtia Cataphracta; [cf. पाक-फल and कृष्ण-पाकफल।] —फलपाकान्त (°क-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ending with the ripening of fruit; (आ), f. an annual plant. —फलपाकावसाना (°क-अव्°), f. ‘terminating with ripeness of fruit,’ an annual plant. —फलपाकिन्, ई, m. the plant Thespesia Popul-neoides. —फल-पातन, अम्, n. knocking down or gathering fruit. —फल-पादप, अस्, m. a fruit tree. —फल-पुच्छ, अस्, m. a particular species of esculent root or bulb. —फल-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a city (= फलक-पुर). —फल-पुष्प-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase or growth of fruits and flowers. —फल-पुष्पा or फल-पुष्पी, f. Ipomœa Turpethum (= पिण्ड-खर्जूरी). —फल-पुष्पोपशोभित (°प-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with fruits and flowers. —फल-पूर or फल-पूरक, अस्, m. ‘full of kernels,’ common citron. —फल-प्रचयन, अम्, n. fruit-gathering, gather-ing fruits. —फल-प्रजनन, अम्, n. the produc-tion of fruit. —फल-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, yielding fruit, productive; bringing a reward. —फल-प्र-दान, अम्, n. the giving of fruits; a ceremony at weddings. —फल-प्रयुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, connected with or producing consequences, yielding fruit. —फल-प्रसूति, इस्, f. a growth of fruit, crop of fruit. —फल-प्राप्ति, इस्, f. obtaining (the desired) fruit or result; enjoying the consequences of actions. —फल-प्रिया, f. a species of fragrant plant (= प्रियङ्गु). —फल-प्रेप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to obtain fruit, desirous of attaining results. —फल-बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, forming or developing fruit, setting (said of blossom). —फल-बन्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, barren or destitute of fruit, not bearing fruit; [cf. फलाबन्ध्य।] —फल-भाग, अस्, m. a share in any product, share of advantage or profit; N. of an astrological work. —फल-भागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sharing in the profit or advantage, partaking of a reward. —फल-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, receiving or having fruit, having consequences; sharing in a reward. —फल-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, enjoying fruit. —फल-भूति, इस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —फल-भूमि, इस्, f. ‘the land of retribution,’ a place of reward or recompense (as heaven, hell, &c.). —फल-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, fruit-bearing, fruitful, productive. —फल-भोग, अस्, m. enjoyment of consequences; possession of rent or profit, usufruct. —फल-भोगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, enjoying fruits or consequences, receiving profits. —फल-मत्स्या, f. the aloe plant. —फल-मु-ख्या, f. a species of plant (= अज-मोदा). —फल-मुद्गरिका, f. a kind of date tree (= पिण्ड-खर्-जूरी). —फल-मूल, अम्, n. or ए, n. du. or आनि, n. pl. fruits and roots. —फलमूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having (edible) fruits and roots. —फल-योग, अस्, m. the attainment of an object; remuneration, wages. —फल-राजन्, आ, m. ‘king of the fruits,’ a water-melon. —फल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, fruit-bearing, fruc-tiferous, covered or laden with fruits, fruitful; yielding results or consequences, successful, profitable, advan-tageous; फलक: फलक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (at the end of an adj. comp., f. इका), = फल, fruit, result, consequence, profit, gain; menstruation [cf. नव-फलिकी]; a shield; (अस्), m. the plant Mesua Roxburghii; (अम्), n. a board, lath, plank, a bench; a slab at the base (of a pedestal; cf. स्फटिक-फ्°); any flat sur-face [cf. फणा-फ्°]; a slab or tablet for writing on [cf. चित्र-फ्°, लिपि-फ्°]; a leaf or page for writing on; the stand on which a Buddhist priest keeps his turban; a broad and flat bone, the os frontis or bone of the forehead; the palm of the hand; the buttocks; a particular vessel; a kind of cloth; the top or head of an arrow; the pericarp of a lotus; (आ), f. a various reading for हलका in Gaṇa Prek-ṣādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80. —फलक-पाणि, इस्, m. a soldier armed with a shield. —फलक-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town in the east of India; [cf. फल-पुर।] —फलक-यन्त्र, अम्, n. an astronomical instrument invented by Bhāskara. —फलक-सक्-थ, अम्, n. a thigh like a board, (Scholiast on Pāṇ. V. 4, 98.) —फलका-वन or फलकी-वन, अम्, n., N. of a forest sacred to Sarasvatī. —फलकासा-दन (°क-आस्°), अम्, n. the obtaining or reaching a plank (said of a drowning person).

फलत्: फलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bearing or yielding fruit; producing consequences; bringing gain or profit. —फलज्-जल-वासुदेव, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
फलन: फलन, अम्, n. bearing fruit, fructifying; pro-ducing consequences.

फलि: फलि, इस्, m. a kind of fish commonly Phalai.
फलिका: फलिका, f. a kind of bean (= निष्-पावी); Thes-pesia Populneoides.
फलित: फलित, अस्, आ, अम्, that has produced fruit, bearing fruit, yielding fruit, fruitful; yielding a result, followed by a consequence, successful; fulfilled, ac-complished (as a desire); produced as a consequence; फलितं वृक्षैः, fruit was borne by the trees, the trees bore fruit; (अस्), m. a tree (properly a fruit tree); (आ), f. a menstruous woman; (अम्), n. a kind of perfume (= शैलेय).

फाल्गुन्य: फाल्गुन्य, अस्, m. a metronymic from Phalgunī.
फल्लकिन्: फल्लकिन् फल्लकिन्, ई, m. a kind of fish (= फलकिन्).

फाट्: फाट् फाट्, ind. an interjection of calling.
फाणि: फाणि फाणि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. फण्), unrefined sugar, molasses; flour or meal mixed with curds (= करम्भ).
फाणित: फाणित, अम्, n. (fr. Caus. of rt. फण्), the in-spissated juice of the sugar-cane, raw sugar; the inspissated juice of other plants; [cf. Arab. فانيذ Pers. پانيد medieval Lat. penidium.] —फा-णिती-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, inspissated.
फाण्ट: फाण्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (a contraction of फाणित), obtained by straining or filtering, readily or easily prepared, anything made by an easy process (as a decoction &c.); (अस्), m. an infusion, decoction, pounded medicinal substances mixed with four parts of hot water and filtered; (अम्), n. the first particles of butter that are produced by churning. —फाण्टा-हृत (°ट-आह्°), अस्, m., N. of a man; a patronymic from Phāṇṭāhṛti; (आस्), m. pl. the pupils of Phāṇ-ṭāhṛti. —फाण्टाहृतायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Phāṇṭāhṛti. —फाण्टाहृति, इस्, m., N. of a man; see Pāṇ. IV. 1, 150.
फाण्टक: फाण्टक, अस्, m. an infusion, decoction (= फाण्ट).
फाण्ड: फाण्ड, अम्, n. the belly (= फण्ड).
फाण्डिन्: फाण्डिन्, ई, m., N. of a serpent-demon.
फारिव: फारिव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) = आयुध-वत्।
फालखेला: फालखेला फालखेला, f. a quail; (also read फणिखेल, फलखेल or फलखेला।)
फि: फि फि, इस्, m. a wicked man; useless or idle talk; anger, passion.
फिङ्गक: फिङ्गक फिङ्गक, अस्, m. a kind of bird, the fork-tailed shrike (= कलिङ्ग, कुलिङ्ग).
फिरङ्ग: फिरङ्ग फिरङ्ग, अस्, m. the country of the Franks (i. e. of Europeans); the disease of the Franks, syphilis. —फिरङ्ग-रोटी, f. European bread.
फिरङ्गिन्: फिरङ्गिन्, ई, m. a Frank, a European.
फिराल: फिराल फिराल, N. of a place.
फिरिण्ड: फिरिण्ड फिरिण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
फु: फु फु, उस्, m. a magical formula; useless or idle talk.
फुक: फुक फुक, अस्, m. a bird.
फुट: फुट फुट, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. the hood or expanded neck of a snake (= फट, फण).
फुट्टिका: फुट्टिका फुट्टिका, f. a sort of woven texture.
फुत्: फुत् फुत् or फूत्, an onomatopoetic word imitative of the sound made by blowing or puffing into liquids, or by the boiling or bubbling of water, &c.; sometimes expressive of disregard or contempt; (used only in connection with rt. कृ।) —फुत्-कर, अस्, m. ‘making a blowing or crackling noise,’ fire. —फुत्-कर्तु-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, wishing to make a derisory noise, intending to cry aloud. —फुत्-कार or फूत्-कार, अस्, m. blowing, hissing, whiz-zing; the hiss of a serpent; shouting loudly, shriek-ing, screaming. —फुत्कार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, hissing; shrieking. —फुत्-कार्य in अ-फुत्कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, requiring no blowing. —फुत्-कृ or फूत्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to blow, blow into; to scream, shriek, screech. —फुत्-कृत or फूत्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, blown, blown on, blown into, breathed in, cooled by blowing into; blown up (as a bubble); screamed aloud; (अम्), n. the sound of a wind instrument; a loud scream, shriek. —फुत्-कृति or फूत्-कृति, इस्, f. blowing, hissing; screaming.
फुप्फु: फुप्फु फुप्फु, ind. an onomatopoetic word. —फुप्फु-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, panting, gasping.
फुप्फुस: फुप्फुस, अस्, अम्, m. n. the lungs; [cf. पुप्-फुस; Gr. φῦ-σα, φυσά-ω.]
फुम्फुआ: फुम्फुआ फुम्फुआ, ind. imitation of the sound made by the crackling of fire.
फुलिङ्ग: फुलिङ्ग फुलिङ्ग, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), syphilis; [cf. फिरङ्ग।]
फुल्ल्: फुल्ल् फुल्ल् (more properly regarded as a Nom. fr. फुल्ल), cl. 1. P. फुल्लति, पुफुल्ल, &c., to open, expand (as a flower), bloom, blossom, blow, flower.
फुल्लन: फुल्लन, अस्, ई, अम्, filling with air, inflating.
फुल्लरीक: फुल्लरीक फुल्लरीक, अस्, m. a district, place; a snake, serpent.
फूत्: फूत् फूत्, फूत्-कार, &c. See फुत् above.
फेञ्चक: फेञ्चक फेञ्चक, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
फेट्: फेट् फेट्, ind. an onomatopoetic word (= फेत्). —फेट्-कार, अस्, m. howling, a howl. —फेट्-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, howling. —फेट्कारिणी-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work on magic.
फेण्ट: फेण्ट फेण्ट, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
फेत्: फेत् फेत्, ind. an onomatopoetic word. —फेत्-कार, अस्, m. howling (of the wind or of animals). —फेत्-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, howling; (इणी), f., N. of a Tantra. —फेत्कारीय, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra. —फेत्-कृत, अम्, n. howling, a howl.
फेन: फेन फेन or फेण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. फे, substituted for rt. स्फाय्, Uṇādi-s. III. 3; by some derived fr. rt. फण्), foam, froth, spume; scum [cf. दुग्ध-फ्°, पयः-फेनी]; foam of the mouth, moisture of the lips, saliva [cf. वृषली-फेन-पीत, फणि-फ्°]; (अस्), m. white cuttle-fish bone, os sepiæ, supposed to be indurated foam of the sea [cf. अब्धि-कफ, अब्धि-फ्°, समुद्र-फ्°]; N. of a son of Ushad-ratha and father of Su-tapas; (आ), f. a species of shrub, = सातला; (ई), f. a kind of food; [cf. Lat. spūma; Angl. Sax. fam, fœman; Slav. pêna, ‘foam.’] —फेन-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain near the mouth of the Indus; (also written फेण-गिरि।) —फेन-ता, f. frothiness, vapour. —फेन-दुग्धा, f. a kind of small shrub (= दुग्ध-फेनी). —फे-न-प, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘froth-drinking, foam-quaffing,’ feeding on foam; (according to a Scholiast = स्वयम् पतितैः फलादिभिर् जीवन्; also spelt फेण-प।) —फेन-पिण्ड, अस्, m. ‘a mass of foam,’ a mere bubble, any mere fancy, empty idea, nonentity, nonsense. —फेन-प्रख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, foam-like, resembling foam. —फेन-मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dis-charging frothy urine. —फेन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, frothy, foaming, bubbling. —फेन-वाहिन्, ई, m. ‘carrying off the scum,’ a filtering cloth; ‘foam-bearing,’ (perhaps) the thunderbolt of Indra (Indra having used the foam of the sea for his thunderbolt to kill the demon Vṛtra); (perhaps rather) an epi-thet of Indra; [cf. फेनाशनि।] —फेनाग्र (°न-अग्°), अम्, n. ‘surface of foam,’ a bubble on the water. —फेनाशनि (°न-अश्°), इस्, m. ‘having foam for a thunderbolt,’ an epithet of Indra. —फेनाहार (°न-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, living on foam, feeding on froth. —फेनोपम (°न-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, foam-like, resembling foam (said of life).
फेनक: फेनक, अस्, m. white cuttle-fish bone, os sepiæ; (अस्, आ), m. f. a kind of pastry; ground rice boiled in water; the soap-berry?; (इका), f. a kind of pre-pared food; froth.
फेनल: फेनल, अस्, आ, अम्, frothy, foamy; [cf. फेनिल।]
फेनाय: फेनाय, Nom. A. फेनायते, -यितुम्, to foam, froth.
फेनायमान: फेनायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, foaming, frothing.
फेनिल: फेनिल, अस्, आ, अम्, foamy, frothy, spumous; (अस्), m. the soap plant, Sapindus Detergens; the plant Zizyphus Jujuba, = बदर; (आ), f. a species of plant (= बाम्ब, बाम्बी, जल-ब्रह्मी, सर्पाक्षी); the plant Sapindus Detergens; (अम्), n. (probably) the fruit of Sapindus Detergens; the fruit of Zizyphus Jujuba; the fruit of Madana.
फेन्य: फेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. existing in foam; (Mahī-dhara) = डिण्डिरे भवः।
फेर: फेर फेर, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic word; cf. फेट्, फेत्), a jackal.
फेरल: फेरल फेरल, N. of a place; (perhaps wrongly for केरल।)
फेरव: फेरव फे-रव, अस्, m. (fr. फे onomato-poetic + रव), a jackal; a Rākṣasa, a goblin, a demon; (अस्, आ, अम्), fraudulent, crafty, a rogue, a cheat; malicious, noxious, injurious.
फेल्: फेल् फेल्, cl. 1. P. फेलति, &c., to go, move.
फेल: फेल फेल, अम्, आ, n. f. remnants of food, leavings of a meal, droppings from the mouth, refuse, orts; a particular high number.
फेलि: फेलि, इस्, or फेली, f. remnants of food.
फेसल: फेसल फेसल (?), N. of a place.
फौल्लि: फौल्लि फौल्लि (fr. फुल्ल), see Scholiast on Vārttika III. to Pāṇ. VIII. 2, 42.
फिट्सूत्र: फिट्-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of certain Sūtras on accent by Śāntanava.
